reviews.t: Great bang for your buck; beautiful blonde shade.
reviews.x: I will update after a few more wears, but so far, so good. I cut it, did a curl set and steamed the curls with a clothing steamer to set and brushed out. The shade of blonde is very pretty, it is sort of a lightest ash blonde, not entirely platinum but not as yellow as a #613. It has dimension and just the right amount of shine. Super soft. reviews.t: Hands down the best wig ever!!!
reviews.x: I have been buying wigs for about 7 years now and I can honestly say this is the best quality wig I have gotten yet. This is the second time I have purchased this wig and definitely will be purchasing again. The hair is so soft, the hairline is realistic and doesn’t  shed or tangle. Every other wig I have purchased I have had to add hair to,  fix the hairline and cut. I didn’t have to do anything to this wig... it’s PERFECT!!  And the price can’t be beat. I have spent twice as much on other wigs
This blonde color is super platinum and beautiful, thick and full with minimal shedding, glad I purchased!

And once the wig was on the entire top back half of the wig is all broken little hairs that stick straight up making the wig look tore up for being brand new. Also as soft as the wig was it had that worn in feeling when it comes to

Wow! This wig is amazing. I have quite a few wigs and this is by far my favorite. The hairline is so natural looking and it's very thick. It's also very soft. It's long and only sheds a small amount. It doesn't tangle too bad but it's a synthetic wig so it obviously will a little. It's also heat resistant. I used 300 degrees (Fahrenheit) on it and it was fine. Since it's a lace front, you can part the wig however you'd like and it still looks natural. But you definitely get your money's worth wi

The wig is very soft, looks beautiful,but there is absolutely no parting space. Like absolutely none. You can only wear it like in one style that will hide the tracks. That cute little braid up style looks a mess in real life because all everyone can see is the weave tracks. Near the weave tracks the hair is not so silky. The wig would be perfect if it had some parting space and more lace in the front.

I live for this wig- I wear it all the time for fun, and I have several cosplay plans involving it. I can wear it for long periods of time, and it fits and sticks like a charm with just a little bit of spirit gum. It’s a bit blonder than it looks in the pictures, but it still works perfectly.
Great quality for such cheap price ! I love it

I have naturally black hair, and wanted to see what I'd look like blonde, so after reading other reviews i decided to purchase this wig and its absolutely stunning. I did add a shadow root with eyeshadow to make it look a bit more natural with my dark brows that are difficult to lighten with makeup, but otherwise its a fantastic wig. Cons: it does tangle, a lot. So if you don't want nearly as much tangli

I had hopes when I took the we go to the package as it was beautiful but you really can’t do very much to it unless you want tracks bulging out of your head. I recommend you look elsewhere for a blond wig. This was very

You’ll need to soak it in fabric softer and add dry shampoo bc she gives off miss  shiny. I’m using her for elsa and it’s thick enough to not have tracks show and not TOO hot. It isn’t soft it feels like a wig. And it is a bit yellow. It’s very beach wave and it’s not straight at the top. I put it in barrel curlers hoping that would help and it did a little bit. It’s a HARD middle part but I wore it crooked and it worked. Haven’t tried heat on it.

This is beautiful! I cut it shorter, and straightened it to match closer to what my natural hair looked like. I'm trying to avoid hair dye, bleach or heat on my natural hair so this helps me feel more beautiful while I'm going months and months of not doing any possible damage to my hair (even extensions are harmful!) I'm fully satisfied and omgosh the hair is sooooo soft! My husband even told me it felt so good!!

The hairline is amazing. I got many compliments I use got2be glued to help secure it... I I'll say I think I have a big head & it is way to big in the back & there is not a hair clasp to secure in the back if those two things were different I'd give a 5 star. I it easy to get the tangles out, it isnt too shiny I also used a dry shampoo to make it look a bit more real. But over all it is a beautiful unit.

The hair is soft and bouncy. The hairline is plugged nicely too but could be added to If you wanted. Since the hair is synthetic I wouldn’t recommend straightening it. I did and changed texture and didn’t look as good as before. The unit fits well and has convenient strap to adjust fit. Feels very secure.  The vendor is very respectable and easy to communicate with.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the wig as great value for the price, calling it a good deal and decent quality for the cost.
Many customers describe the hair as soft and the hairline as natural-looking.
Several reviewers note the wig sheds and tangles at least a little, though some say shedding is minimal.
Some reviewers complain the received wig does not match the product photos or has poor quality details like visible tracks and uneven cutting.
A few reviewers report issues with parting space or styling limitations.
